nom: Vichy Aqualia Thermal Crème Hydratante Riche Acide Hyaluronique Peaux Sèches

avis.texte: produit hyper hydratant, non gras ; que j'utilise le soir avant le coucher

avis.titre: Je connais le produit. Seul bémol
avis.texte: Je connais le produit. Seul bémol: l'emballage de la crème était ouvert et abîmé
Pas vraiment convaincu. Je n'ai pas pu observer d'effets particuliers. Je ne peux donc pas me prononcer positivivement.

Ich bin sehr zufrieden mit dieser Gesichtscreme. Sie hat eine sehr angenehme Konsistenz, lässt sich leicht auftragen und zieht gut in die Haut ein. Nach der Anwendung fühlt sich die Haut weich, gepflegt und angenehm an. Die Creme spendet Feuchtigkeit, ohne zu fetten. Ich kann sie auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen.

I have been using various facial products that claimed miracles (never happened) but, honestly, Vichy line seems to really do what it says it will do. I have a normal to combination skin but find the products for dry skin perform much better in cold (winter) weather. I have been purchasing the "Rich" version at my local Shoppers' but found Amazon offers the cream at lower price. Although this cream is geared towards "dry to very dry" skin, I find it non greasy, and my face just drinks it in. The moisture delivered really lasts a very long time although I can't tell if it lasts 48 hours, as it claims; I wash my face morning and evening, and apply this cream twice a day, after washing. It does plump my 63 y/o face and the hyaluronic really smoothes the lines (mine are mostly around my mouth). I'll most likely switch to the lighter version for warmer weather.

Me encanta esta crema. Que pena que ya esté descatalogada, al menos en España... Me deja la piel suave, super hidratada y nada pringosa. Mi piel la absorbe increíblemente bien y queda como de terciopelo, es como si fuera suya.

Avevo letto recensioni negative sul prodotto, ma utilizzando Vichy da tanti anni l'ho acquistato lo stesso e ho fatto bene perchè è una crema eccezionale, superidratante come la cercavo, senza profumo e non unge. Distende anche le rughe e da quando la uso mattina e sera vedo la pelle notevolmente migliorata. Continuerò ad acquistarla. Grazie Vichy, grazie Amazon.
